rules.statement: A vendee is bound by the terms of a deed of transfer, including conditions for retransfer, even if not signed by the vendee.
rules.supporting_quote: A deed of transfer of a land embodying a condition to retransfer on payment of the purchase price plus interest within five years binds the vendee to retransfer the land on being paid the purchase price and interest within the stipulated time although the vendee had not signed the deed. The property was transferred with a condition attached to it. The condition cannot be disengaged from the property. The failure of the defendant-appellant to sign the deed does not entitle him to wriggle out of his obligation to retransfer. The obligation was intrinsic in the transfer itself

meta.parties: Gnanasambandam v. Bin Adaham and Another
